correction: The successful later run stores one 64-character lowercase ASCII hex secret in the receiver file and sends exactly that text to Forgejo.
root_cause: The run wrote 32 binary random bytes to the receiver secret file but sent the hex text of those bytes to Forgejo; both sides therefore computed HMAC with different keys. The actual Forgejo task was delivered to the receiver and rejected with HTTP 401.
scope: Run 004 emitted an actual issue webhook but did not reach mission admission; no secret or payload was copied into this diagnosis.
